propositions: rebar config validate scans only tombstones and bypasses typed coercion, causing invalid enum values like reconciler.rich_text_cutover to pass validation with exit 0
setting reconciler.rich_text_cutover to an invalid value such as 'clould' is accepted by config validate but rejected by config command
the command's name and success message imply full configuration validation, creating false confidence for operators with malformed live keys
rebar config validate must aggregate typed-value coercion errors and enum constraint violations alongside tombstone diagnostics in a single run with non-zero exit on failure
the fix implements canonical per-key coercers across user/project/env/CLI layers while skipping store auto-mounting only for config validate to preserve aggregation
